note: Session 1: actual Meta AI replies to a scripted, fictional café scenario (not a real user). Session 2: a generated mock-up of a generic AI chat.

frames.caption: They ask Meta AI for a premium poster for a new dessert. Meta AI makes one straight away.
“Still not premium enough. Make it more premium.”
“Even more premium, please.” — the fourth vague request.
They write a specific brief: who, what, price, feeling, and no real photo yet. Meta AI also added opening hours nobody gave it — unverified.
A week later, in a chat that starts with the Caddie card: the AI asks first.
